title: Malty Ceviche with Jazzy Melons
description: A refreshing mexican ceviche dish featuring malty flavors and paired with sweet jazzy melons.

ingredients.name: Raw halibut
ingredients.notes: Make sure to buy sashimi-grade fish

ingredients.name: Jazzy melons
ingredients.notes: Choose a mix of sweet and tart melons

ingredients.name: Malty
ingredients.notes: A specialty malty syrup or substitute with a combination of malt extract and water

ingredients.name: Portuguese sea salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: Ceviche marinade
ingredients.notes: A mixture of lime juice, garlic, and spices

instructions: 1. Cut the halibut into small pieces and place in a large bowl.
2. In a separate bowl, mix together the malty, portuguese sea salt, and ceviche marinade.
3. Pour the marinade mixture over the halibut and toss to coat.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
5. Slice the jazzy melons into small pieces and set aside.
6. Just before serving, stir the halibut mixture and adjust seasoning as needed.
7. Serve the halibut mixture over the sliced melons and garnish with additional malty syrup if desired.
